name: Gelkak Gyromast
summary: Along Mist's Edge in northern Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast is stranded after threshadons sank his ship. The gnome talks like a pirate captain and wants his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, working again.

sections.title: Castaway on Mist's Edge
sections.body: West of the Ruins of Mathystra, Gelkak Gyromast is stranded on Darkshore's northern coast. The gnome talks like an old sea dog and calls himself captain. Threshadons sank his ship just offshore, and he washed up on the misty shore. The key to his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, broke on the rocks. Crawlers, foreststriders and murlocs rummaging through the wreckage carried off its pieces.

sections.title: The Threshwackonator Malfunction
sections.body: Once travelers recover the key, Gelkak sends them to switch on the Threshwackonator 4100 and lead it back to him. He hopes to set it against the murlocs and beasts along the coast. The machine follows obediently, then malfunctions and turns hostile as it reaches its captain. The travelers must destroy it.

faq.answer: Gelkak Gyromast is stranded on Mist's Edge, the northern beach of Darkshore just west of the Ruins of Mathystra. The gnome talks like a pirate captain.

faq.q: Why is Gelkak stranded in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Threshadons sank Gelkak's ship just offshore, and he washed up on Darkshore's northern coast with the broken key to his mechanical first mate.
The Threshwackonator 4100 is Gelkak's mechanical creation and self-proclaimed first mate. He wants it working again so it can take revenge on the murlocs and beasts along the coast.

faq.q: What help does Gelkak need from travelers?
faq.answer: Gelkak asks travelers to recover the three pieces of his broken key from the coast's crawlers, foreststriders and murlocs. Then they can start the Threshwackonator 4100 and lead it back to him.

angles.text: As a gnome, seeing one of your own stranded on the edge of Kalimdor shows how far your adventures can carry you from home.
As an engineer, you can see Gelkak's hopes of revenge pinned on his impressive device, the Threshwackonator 4100.
